Requirement: The robot shall support caregivers and visibly identify itself as a research support robot with no professional-care authority.
Overall height shall target 1.829 m; provisional build acceptance band is 1.809 to 1.849 m pending owner acceptance.
Operating robot mass including battery, panels and attached handling module shall target <=55 kg; weigh each permitted configuration.
A projected mass >55 kg shall trigger rework; >65 kg shall trigger a major design review and suspend affected purchases and motion releases.
The lower body shall contain exactly 10 independently commanded active joints; joint topology requires design freeze.
The walking demonstration shall complete three alternating consecutive steps in each of two separate supervised trials.
Walking speed shall target 0.10 to 0.15 m/s over the defined three-step interval, using measured distance and synchronized time.
All walking shall occur within an approved cleared test area using inspected rated robot fall protection and an exclusion zone.
Total Year 1 cash outlay shall remain <=USD 10000; USD 5000 is the lower funding case and unapproved commitments are prohibited.
The exterior shall use rigid removable white plastic panels, narrow visible seams, protected charcoal joint gaps and subtle teal accents.
The robot shall use broad flat rounded-rectangle feet without toes or circular stumps and a simple two-eye line face.
Panels shall permit full approved motion, ventilation, fall-protection attachment, sensor views, emergency-stop access and fastener service.
A safety controller shall independently inhibit hazardous motion and shall have no conversational-model bypass path.
Local and operator emergency stops, power loss, watchdog faults and restart shall produce the reviewed safe state without automatic re-energization.
Signed versioned motion limits shall cover position, speed, current, temperature and relevant force; missing limits shall inhibit motion.
Motion requests shall pass through deterministic authorization and bounded prevalidated skills; conversational text shall have no motor-bus access.
Every session shall use fictional profiles and simulated values, with persistent SIMULATED labels on screens, exports and transmissions.
Profiles shall hold consented preferences and consent scope, and support withdrawal with an auditable action.
Companion mode shall support friendly conversation, jokes, stories, music or relaxation and at least one trivia, memory, word and matching activity.
Interaction shall offer child, adult, older-adult, rehabilitation and limited-speech or mobility presets with caregiver control.
Unclear input shall cause clarification; sensitive or clinically important input shall offer human handoff and avoid clinical advice.
Scheduled social check-ins and an approved caregiver audio or video call shall be demonstrated with consent and visible connection state.
Each observation shall retain simulated flag, value, unit, source, observed time, recorded time, actor and unique record identifier.
Patient notes, caregiver notes, appointment and activity logs, trends and shift summaries shall preserve source and statement type.
Record corrections shall create linked revisions preserving originals and shall audit create, view, change and transmit events.
The local mock FHIR-style interface shall export human-readable reports and reject live EHR endpoint configuration.
Medication screens shall show original human-entered simulated instructions verbatim with version and schedule provenance.
User-configured medication reminders shall log taken, skipped, postponed or no response without inferring ingestion.
A scripted missed dose shall prepare an approved-recipient notice; sending requires explicit confirmation of the exact preview.
Medication changes shall require an authorized human confirmation and retain before and after versions; double-dose and schedule advice shall be blocked.
Simulated wellness logging shall include heart rate, oxygen saturation, temperature, activity, steps, rest, pain, mood, fatigue, appetite and sleep.
Hydration, posture and scheduled movement prompts shall be configurable non-treatment reminders; physical rehab motion requires a separately approved script.
Crossing a scripted demonstration threshold shall display source, value, units and time and offer caregiver contact without diagnosis or emergency conclusions.
Non-medical perception shall demonstrate room mapping, obstacle and blocked-path detection, QR or barcodes, labels, printed text and approved objects.
Object pose and visible changes shall be demonstrated only on approved training objects and shall make uncertainty visible.
Outbound care reports shall use an allowlist and explicit approval bound to recipient, report version and content hash; altered drafts require reapproval.
Report previews shall distinguish measured simulation facts, patient statements, robot observations and unknowns, with timestamps and robot status.
The communication service shall audit attempts, deduplicate retries, show endpoint acknowledgement separately from human review and retain a manual call button.
Communication priority shall be routine, caregiver attention, immediate human contact requested or system assistance; no level shall imply a medical diagnosis.
A 2 kg inert object shall move through a defined supported stationary handling trajectory for 10 supervised repetitions.
Handling shall log payload, position, current, temperature, relevant force and stop events; approved limits and compliant retention shall be verified before load.
Walking shall be interlocked against attached test payload; handling shall require a mechanically secured stationary configuration.
Evidence shall include configuration, software version, model version, calibration, raw synchronized logs, outcome and limitations for each executed test.

Major procurement and fabrication shall require accepted requirements, frozen interfaces, mass, torque-speed, thermal and power models, simulation, quotes, independent review, named fabricator and inspection plan.
Integration shall follow the 16-stage test order; two previously unvalidated hazardous subsystems shall not be combined in a public demonstration.
Privacy mode shall visibly disable camera and microphone capture; endpoint outage shall preserve local control, records and truthful communication state.
Safety, thermal and electrical faults shall generate deterministic local indications; AI and network failure shall not prevent emergency stopping.
Software-only caregiver functions shall be demonstrated on a laptop before powered walking integration.
Every alert and action shall explain its observed trigger, rule or authorization, action and unresolved uncertainty.
Cleaning and battery maintenance instructions shall match selected materials and components and be reviewed before physical demonstration.
A 5 kg payload may be reconsidered only after structural, actuation, thermal, electrical, stability and safety review; it is not a Year 1 commitment.
Supply carts, powered trolleys, cargo drawers and detachable handling modules shall be evaluated before increasing biped payload.
Live care-system integration, real patient data or patient studies shall require separate privacy, clinical, cybersecurity, governance and applicable regulatory reviews.
Any medical-scanning subsystem shall have separate clinical and regulatory scope, validation and authorization before development release.
Untethered walking, turning, stairs, public-area navigation and walking with cargo shall require new requirements and safety cases.
Multilingual interaction, room controls, family media, delivery requests and clinician-directed rehabilitation shall require separate benefit and risk review.
The robot shall not diagnose, recommend treatment, interpret clinical scans or claim disease detection.
The robot shall not prescribe, select, dispense, administer, calculate doses or alter medication instructions autonomously.
The robot shall never lift, catch, transfer, restrain or physically support a person.
The robot shall not promise emergency dispatch, successful human review or professional-care replacement.
Early development shall not store or transmit real patient information or connect to live EHRs.
The project shall not use inflatable exterior, combat, superhero or military styling.
No unsupervised high-energy motion or unapproved public operation shall be permitted.
No function shall be reported as passed without identifiable executed test evidence and reviewer disposition.
